scripts.start: node -e "const s=process.env.STUDIO_SESSION_SECRET||''; if(s.length<32){console.error('STUDIO_SESSION_SECRET must be set and at least 32 characters long.'); process.exit(1)}; const Module=require('module'), fs=require('fs'), path=require('path'), visitor=path.resolve('./visitor-server.js'), originalLoader=Module._extensions['.js']; Module._extensions['.js']=function(module,filename){ if(path.resolve(filename)===visitor){ let source=fs.readFileSync(filename,'utf8'); source=source.replace('const expectedOrigin = `${forwardedProto}://${host}`;', 'const expectedOrigin = forwardedProto + "://" + host;'); return module._compile(source,filename); } return originalLoader(module,filename); }; require('./visitor-server.js')"
